description: This source file contains functions related to monitoring utilities, including managing timers, updating states, handling notifications, and initializing/destroying monitor objects within a larger system for wireless LAN monitoring.

classes.name: T_Monitor
classes.description: Data structure representing a monitor instance, containing state, configuration, timer, and callback information.

methods.name: void wld_mon_sendUpdateNotification(amxd_object_t * eventObject,const char * name,amxc_var_t * variant)
methods.description: Sends an update notification by triggering a signal with the specified event object, name, and variant data.

methods.name: void timeHandler(amxp_timer_t * timer,void * data)
methods.description: Timer callback that invokes the user-defined callback function associated with the monitor.

methods.name: void startMonitor(T_Monitor * pMon)
methods.description: Starts the monitor timer with the configured interval.

methods.name: void wld_mon_updateEnabled(T_Monitor * pMon)
methods.description: Enables or disables the monitor based on active and enabled state, starting or stopping the timer accordingly.

methods.name: void wld_mon_setEnable_pwf(T_Monitor * pMon,const amxc_var_t * const newValue)
methods.description: Updates the monitor's enabled state and adjusts its operational status.

methods.name: void wld_mon_setInterval_pwf(T_Monitor * pMon,const amxc_var_t * const newValue)
methods.description: Sets the interval for the monitor's timer and updates the running timer if active.

methods.name: amxd_status_t s_objDelete(amxd_object_t * const object _UNUSED,amxd_param_t * const param _UNUSED,amxd_action_t reason _UNUSED,const amxc_var_t * const args _UNUSED,amxc_var_t * const retval _UNUSED,void * priv)
methods.description: Handle for object deletion, clears the private data reference and confirms cleanup.

methods.name: void wld_mon_initMon(T_Monitor * pMon,amxd_object_t * object,char * name,void * userData,void (* callback_fn)(void * userData))
methods.description: Initializes a monitor object with parameters, callback, and configuration for runtime operation.

methods.name: void wld_mon_destroyMon(T_Monitor * pMon)
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources associated with a monitor.

methods.name: void wld_mon_writeActive(T_Monitor * pMon,bool active)
methods.description: Sets the active state of the monitor and updates its enabled status.

methods.name: void wld_mon_debug(T_Monitor * pMon,amxc_var_t * retMap)
methods.description: Fills a return map with the current debug/status info of a monitor.
